pairs.contract: Expiration timestamps are exclusive: expired at now >= deadline. None means no expiration; zero is a valid deadline. Preserve input records; return active records in input order.
pairs.verification:
records = [{'expires_at': None}, {'expires_at': 0}, {'expires_at': 10}, {'expires_at': 11}]
original = copy.deepcopy(records)
assert fn(records, 10) == [records[0], records[3]]
assert records == original
assert fn([{'expires_at': 0}], -1) == [{'expires_at': 0}]
assert fn([{}], 100) == [{}]
pairs.reference: return [r for r in records if r.get('expires_at') is None or now < r['expires_at']]

pairs.contract: Return an independently editable copy of each configuration: nested lists/dicts must not alias originals or other returned records. Preserve values and input order; never mutate inputs.
pairs.verification:
shared = {'nested': {'items': [1, {'value': 2}]}}
records = [shared, shared]
original = copy.deepcopy(records)
result = fn(records)
assert result == original
result[0]['nested']['items'][1]['value'] = 9
assert records == original
assert result[1] == original[1]
assert fn([]) == []

pairs.contract: Normalize identifier keys by stripping whitespace and casefolding. Reject blank normalized keys and any collision with ValueError even if values agree. Preserve values; never mutate inputs.
